concepts.finding: two status machines (created/preparing/ready/running/stopping/stopped/completed/failed; runner idle..failed), monitor polls action logs every 2 s, per-simulation finalisation lock; 'paused' declared but unreachable

concepts.finding: LLM writes hot topics and initial posts; posts mapped to agents by entity type then alias then influence; injected as forced round-0 actions

concepts.finding: activity config with many fields of which only active_hours and activity_level are read at runtime (dead parameters)

concepts.finding: per-platform SQLite inside OASIS, deleted at run start
concepts.commerce: one authoritative per-run market store rebuilt fresh

concepts.finding: rounds = hours*60/minutes_per_round (default 72); per round an activation set chosen by unseeded random sampling with hour multipliers; concurrent LLM steps (semaphore 30); order nondeterministic
concepts.commerce: discrete-time loop with explicit activation sets and an atomic market step logged per tick

concepts.finding: closed platform action sets (6 Twitter, 13 Reddit); LLM chooses via tool calls over a recommender feed

deterministic market-clearing function over chosen actions

concepts.finding: fixed round count or signal; no convergence test

concepts.finding: two platforms concurrently in one process; no Monte-Carlo replicates

concepts.finding: filesystem command queue; interview injects a manual action and reads the answer from the trace

concepts.finding: LLM proposes horizon, cadence and per-agent parameters; some multipliers never applied

whole_source_findings: Simulated agent activity is written into the same graph as document-derived facts; readers (get_graph_data, ZepEntityReader, search tools) neither filter nor expose the difference
The report agent frames simulation output as predicted future facts and quotes agent output as core evidence; interview output is described as real answers, not LLM simulation
LLM-generated ontology and analysis summaries are stored beside source data without a generated-by marker; a failed file extraction becomes document text
No RNG seed anywhere: runs cannot be replicated

Reusable clean-room patterns: content-addressed idempotent ingestion with writes never retried, read-only retry honouring Retry-After, cursor non-advance guard, reader leases, strict JSON output validation, coverage-preserving corpus sampling for schema induction
